preconditions: A future sole runtime lease is required. Reconcile exact terminal owner-services and clear-all deltas and seven carried repairs before qualification. No active sibling source was inspected here.
Verify frozen manifest, returned archive/replay and all executable/dependency/generated declaration identities. Prepared dependencies are read-only; never copy node_modules or install.
Create empty scratch HOME/TMPDIR and a pinned proved-bin. Clear environment, close stdin, and bound every child. Every direct or descendant Bun must receive --no-env-file and --no-install.

Prove direct, descendant, failure-path and deadline enforcement with dummy fixtures before any product import. No product launcher is supplied. Historical drivers/wrappers are not safe to run unchanged.

Native listFiles output must prove each required TS entry and every inherited positive assertion is included. Real Svelte compiler input must prove KeyRecorder.svelte and RecorderChecks.svelte are transformed. A callback count or listed file alone is no rendering/axe proof.
The historical declaration/dependency roots in inherited configs must be rebound to exact sealed identities; missing inputs are a gate failure, not an exclusion.

Capture commands, source/helper/dependency/output identities, real PIDs, return codes and explicit waits. Compare complete consumers including EOF twice; never rewrite expected values to match output.
